findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Native pre-capture resource exhaustion still loses handed spend and permits duplicate dispatch after checkpoint replacement
findings.evidence_type: executed native CPython resource failure; no owner/private implementation patch in this probe
findings.smallest_reproduction: probe_native.py depth145 or146 with recursionlimit150: construct battery fixture and desk; save ledger checkpoint; dispatch once (executor settles run.1); call reader.pinned through deep native call stack; catch RecursionError; replace handed ledger dictionary value with saved checkpoint; dispatch the same admitted action.
findings.actual_result: At depths145 and146 native.log records pending_types=[tuple], redispatch_refused=false, executor_calls=2, sealed=null, diverged=[]. Depth144 retains _RetainedHanding and refuses redispatch; depths141–143 also refuse. Depth147–148 do not establish returned handing and are not used as defect evidence.
findings.expected_result: A spend handed by accounts before capture failed must remain a barrier to re-admission after owner checkpoint replacement; interruption must not implicitly erase it or permanently seal an honest reader.
threat_families: mutable returned dictionary replaced before retry
findings.trust_boundary: Inside documented in-process boundary: ordinary executor settlement and checkpoint replacement plus native recursion exhaustion; no object introspection used to falsify owner state. Instrumentation only reads reader diagnostics after the failed call. This is the explicitly OPEN R17 native-capture family, not a new family.
findings.proposed_correction: Owner decision required for stable publication and acknowledgement lifetime: execution owner retains the exact handed observation until reader acknowledgement, including post-return/pre-registration interruption and failed recovery. A shallow returned mapping alone is insufficient if referenced account state can be rewritten. Keep UNKNOWN/refusal while pending; acknowledgement must mean captured/comparable observation, never merely callback return. Specify abandonment/reset and bounded recovery without treating interruption as corruption. Do not claim durable at-most-once or add a second budget authority.
findings.coverage: Exact-SHA native 19-depth bounded probe; defect evidenced only depths145–146. Existing one-shot post-return recovery controls pass.

repair_assessment: R17 owner JSON parity repair survived 16 existing R17 controls, 16 R16 controls, and 12 new deterministic lifecycle/JSON-boundary controls. No new authority defect established by this lens.
bounds: Read-only source; synthetic software controls only. No scientific validation, certification, full FAST, remote operations or contract implementation.

handoff_lifetime_decision.observation: Reader-side catch/retry cannot reconstruct a prior mapping value after owner replacement if both initial capture and immediate recovery failed. More retries or a fresh stack can improve availability but do not establish publication durability. Permanent poisoning would violate the honest-interruption invariant.
required_decisions: What exact owner-owned observation is published and how long it survives independent of verification stack lifetime
Who acknowledges stable capture, and whether a return with exception can ever acknowledge (should not silently do so)
How immutable/stable entry histories survive mutable account and dictionary replacement
How unacknowledged abandoned verification is recovered or explicitly reset without authorizing rollback
What resource/storage limits cause temporary refusal without silently losing a handing
handoff_lifetime_decision.authority_boundary: Transport retention of existing owner records need not create new scientific or budget authority. Any new ordering/durability obligation is execution-owner semantics and requires explicit approval; current code/docs do not implement it.

canonical JSON outside lock -> concurrent later spend retained in newer barrier -> stale worker refusal, honest later recovery (both owners)
canonical JSON outside lock -> interrupted rollback handing -> later rolled-back account refusal (both owners)
retained canonicalization raises KeyboardInterrupt/MemoryError/RecursionError -> unread spend barrier persists -> rollback refused -> original detached checkpoint recovers (both owners)
R16 single-interruption registration recovery, exact barrier guard and retained alternatives controls
